a.xlink:title:
Load the common observing config, then merge each test-specific config on top, in order (top-level keys of later files override earlier ones).
INPUTS ---------- stem : str Project root (METIS_MAIT_code_eckhart/), prepended to relative paths. *test_config_files : str Test-specific observing configs, relative to stem or absolute.
OUTPUTS ------- dict The merged observing config.

For one filter configuration, centroid the PSF in each dithered FITS file in two passes, as in the other tests: a 1st-pass centroid seeded by guess_x / guess_y from the merged analysis run state (first_pass_centroid), then a Gaussian fit seeded by the 1st-pass centroid. Also writes FYI plots (fyi_fov_dithers_*.png, fyi_fov_per_side_*.png) to results_write_dir.
INPUTS ---------- run_state : dict Merged entry from config_file_IMG_OPT_01_METIS_AIT_img_cal_fov_ANALYSIS.yaml (defaults + one ``runs`` item). Must include ``filter_name`` and a ``dithers`` list with ``guess_x``, ``guess_y``, and ``file_name`` per dither; an optional ``run_label`` distinguishes runs with the same filter and masks. stem : str, optional Project root prepended to relative paths in ``file_name`` and ``results_write_dir``. oversample_factor : int, optional Oversampling factor for both passes. edge_size_oversamp : int, optional Cutout size in oversampled pixels for the Gaussian fit (2nd pass).
OUTPUTS ------- dict ``centroid_results_all`` keyed by dither index. Also writes a pickle under ``results_write_dir``. dict Requirement ID -> verdict (from metis_1095_fov_check), for log_test_outcome.

a.xlink:title:
Decide and log the pass/fail of each IMG-OPT-01 requirement, and of the whole test.
Overall: PASS only if all requirements pass; FAIL if any fails; else INCONCLUSIVE. (Only METIS-1095 for now.)
INPUTS: - verdicts (dict): requirement ID (e.g. 'METIS-1095') -> verdict (PASS, FAIL or INCONCLUSIVE) - run_label (str): the analysis run the verdicts are for (filter, run label)
OUTPUTS: - verdict_overall (str): PASS, FAIL or INCONCLUSIVE
